text: The criterion says older messages of a thread with a very long history load in the overlay as the user scrolls up. No M53 section at 2.1.56 describes this: oo8qeekf and the criterion `ac-po-odswiezeniu-przegladarki-overlay-o` have the overlay restore the FULL history, and the live-join RESTORE cut (cut above the last `user` row, claim the cut prefix's questions) needs every row of the thread. `get-api-threads-id` pages ASC by limit/offset with no total, so fetching the newest page first is not expressible either. Built as a render window over the whole read: the list mounts the newest 60 messages and reveals the next 60 each time it is scrolled to the top (or a 'Scroll up to load N earlier messages' line is clicked), keeping the viewport on the message being read; a thread switch starts from the newest window. Suggest a section under M53 'Stan tury w UI' (or the message list) saying whether 'loading' means a render window or a paged fetch, and with what page size.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0005 — 'older messages load on scroll up' is a render window over the full thread read (newest 60, +60 per scroll to the top); the thread read itself stays whole.
